The '''Vydat Stardock''', also known as '''Vydat Pie''', was a corporate owned [[Space station/Legends|space station]] over [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="University">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref>

[[Dulse Tethin]] served as the [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]].<ref name="University" />

Also, [[The Swirling Vortex]] was located on the space station.<ref name="University" />
